subject: Important Update: New Payment Methods Available
body: Dear valued customers, we are excited to announce that we have integrated additional payment methods to make your shopping experience more convenient. You can now choose to pay using PayPal, Apple Pay, or Google Pay at checkout. We believe this enhancement will streamline the payment process and provide you with more flexibility. Feel free to reach out to our customer support team if you have any questions regarding these new payment options. Thank you for choosing us for your shopping needs!
